label: Investor or regulatory update
summary: Auditable metrics and formal financial precision
No speculative hype or premature regulatory guarantees
writing_style: Structured corporate reporting with clear KPI definitions and standardized accounting disclosures.
messaging_principles: Every performance metric must cite source periods, methodology, and relevant assumptions.

rules.title: Substantiate Investor Projections & Regulatory Status
rules.description: Investor communications must not state speculative financial gains or predict regulatory approvals as certainties.

suggested_replacements.guaranteed 10x ROI: targeted expansion trajectory under current market assumptions
suggested_replacements.stock will explode: aiming for long-term shareholder value creation
suggested_replacements.regulatory approval is 100% in the bag: application remains under active regulatory evaluation

rules.do_example: Q3 operational earnings grew 14% year-over-year in constant currency.
rules.dont_example: Regulatory approval is 100% in the bag and will yield a guaranteed 10x ROI!

terminology.notes: Regulatory status must reflect verified filings.
